meta.title: Froggion — 24/7 AFK bots for game servers
meta.description: Rent AFK bots for Minecraft servers: mob grinding, fishing, auto-mining and auto-farming. Bots run around the clock on our servers and you control them from a web panel. 1 bot for 24 hours free.
meta.ogImageAlt: A floating island where Froggion bots mine, fish, farm and fight creepers

hero.title: AFK bots that keep working while you rest
hero.subtitle: They fight mobs, fish, mine and farm around the clock on our servers. You control them from a web panel on your computer or phone.

scene.label: The Froggion bot island
scene.hint: Hover over a bot to meet it
scene.posterAlt: A floating block island: four bots mine, fish, farm and fight creepers

FroggyMiner.name: Miner Frog
FroggyMiner.description: Loves digging cobblestone, ores and diamonds, but most of all croak-quartz. For fun he goes fishing with Fisher Frog, catching fish and sipping ribbit root beer.

FroggyFisherman.name: Fisher Frog
FroggyFisherman.description: Can sit by the pond with a rod for hours. Catches fish, treasure and old boots, and dreams of an a-croak-rium of his own.

FroggyFarmer.name: Farmer Frog
FroggyFarmer.description: Plants wheat, carrots and potatoes and harvests right on schedule. In winter he pickles cucumbers and croak-ferments cabbage.

FroggySlayer.name: Warrior Frog
FroggySlayer.description: Guards the island from creepers and never misses. Says the best defense is a well-croak-ordinated offense.

attack.title: Mob grinding
attack.text: The bot stands at the farm and hits mobs non-stop while you are busy with other things.

fish.title: Fishing
fish.text: Casts the rod, waits for a bite and reels in. Fish, treasure and experience pile up on their own.

mine.title: Auto-mining
mine.text: Digs tunnels by a profile you set and works around obstacles by itself.

farm.title: Auto-farming
farm.text: Plants and harvests wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot and nether wart.
